title: AI team — provider configuration (MAT-16)
description: Model-agnostic LLM provider configuration. Defines providers, model aliases, and budgets for orchestration.

providers.description: Map of provider_id to provider configuration. At least one provider required.

model_aliases.description: Semantic model names (e.g. 'orchestrator', 'worker') mapped to provider+model.

schema_version.description: Bump only when the config document shape changes.

provider_id.description: Unique identifier for this provider instance (e.g. 'anthropic', 'openai-prod', 'ollama-local').

env_var_name.description: Environment variable name (uppercase with underscores). Never store actual secrets in config.

auth_env.description: Env var containing the API key or auth token. Executor reads this at runtime.

api_base.description: Optional base URL override (for enterprise, self-hosted, or proxy endpoints).

org_id_env.description: Optional env var for organization ID (OpenAI, Anthropic enterprise).

default_headers.description: Optional static headers added to all requests (e.g. custom routing headers).

enabled.description: Set false to disable this provider without removing config.

provider_type.description: Provider type determines API format and capabilities. 'custom' requires api_base.

provider.description: Reference to a provider_id defined in providers map.

model.description: Model identifier as recognized by the provider API (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514').

fallback.description: Optional fallback chain if primary model/provider is unavailable.

max_tokens.description: Optional default max_tokens for this alias; can be overridden per-request.

temperature.description: Optional default temperature for this alias.

rate_limit.description: Client-side rate limiting to stay within provider quotas.

requests_per_minute.description: Max requests per minute to this provider.

defaults.description: Default settings applied when not specified per-alias or per-request.

max_retries.description: Default retry count for transient failures.

budgets.description: Cost and usage guardrails. Executor should enforce these limits.

daily_token_limit.description: Max tokens (all providers combined) per 24h rolling window.

daily_cost_limit_cents.description: Max estimated cost in US cents per 24h rolling window.
